label: ACTUAL LOCAL GEMMA SPEED EXPERIMENT ON LABELED ILLUSTRATIONS; NOT REAL PHOTO ACCURACY VALIDATION
imageLayout: One side-by-side image; before left and after right; 512x384 per source
prompt: Compare LEFT before and RIGHT after. Return schema JSON, one short sentence per list. Visible discarded waste only; never infer quantities, weight, disposal, authenticity or chemical safety. Require human review. Recommend gloves/tools and trained handling of unknown hazards.
